description: Stereo DJ style filter on one bipolar knob: counter-clockwise sweeps a four pole lowpass down, clockwise sweeps a four pole highpass up, and at the centre the signal passes untouched

params.text: Bipolar filter control: the centre passes the signal untouched, counter-clockwise sweeps a lowpass down, clockwise sweeps a highpass up
Emphasises the frequencies around the cutoff, and is scaled down near the centre of FREQ so the untouched position stays clean
Attenuates and inverts the FREQ input before it is added to the FREQ knob
Attenuates and inverts the RES input before it is added to the RES knob

inputs.text: A control voltage added to the FREQ setting, scaled by the FREQ attenuverter
A control voltage added to the RES setting, scaled by the RES attenuverter
The left channel of the audio input, which feeds both channels when it is the only one patched
The right channel of the audio input, which feeds both channels when it is the only one patched

outputs.text: The left channel of the filtered signal
The right channel of the filtered signal
